Tuesday reported an approximately $20M expansion agreement with a long-standing national security customer in the Europe/Middle East/Africa (EMEA) region.
The agreement adds new agentic decision flows to the agency's investigative analytics platform, alongside expanded infrastructure capacity to support the agency's complex mission demands.
“Expanding with agencies we already serve is a key pillar of our growth strategy,” said Elad Sharon, CEO at Cognyte.

title: Cognyte secures ~$20M AI expansion deal with EMEA security customer
